text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy to find out that I'm growing! Trainer tells me that I'll be able to improve even more because of it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But… my running's changed. It feels so awkward and clumsy now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainer is sure I can overcome this, just like I've overcome my other obstacles so far. So I'm feeling a lot more positive about it now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Also, Sky gets completely soaked in the rain for some reason… Maybe I should make her some soup so she doesn't catch a cold.
